name: Luke Kawa
summary: Luke Kawa is named in 1 Part of The Buildout, most recently Part 15: Oil Is the Headline. The Real Yield Is the Bill.. Argued in Part 15 (The boom pays the rate).

parts.headline: Oil Is the Headline. The Real Yield Is the Bill.

sides.claim: He attributes rising global and US Treasury bond yields predominantly to a global growth impulse, especially strength in the industrial side of economies worldwide, which is pushing inflation up and leading central banks to be expected to respond.
He states he is genuinely surprised that the stability of breakevens hasn't given way to more doubt about the Fed's ability to maintain stable inflation after years of missing its target.
